title: Realm of Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji surveyed all living beings from the Realm of Heavenly Secrets, Cang Yutian revealed a meaningful smile—the Chess Game had only just begun.

text.content: Deep within the Mental Sea, at the confluence of three wills, Chen Ji sensed an unprecedented power awakening. It was the moment when the three fragments merged completely—the Tianji Record, whole. Countless runes hung inverted like a galaxy, forming a vast scroll of destiny around him, each pattern reflecting the triple temporal dimensions of past, present, and future.

"So this is... the true realm of Heavenly Secrets?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice carrying an irrepressible tremor. His divine consciousness expanded limitlessly at this moment—every grain of dust, every wisp of breeze within the entire Tianqing Sect fell under his control. What was even more terrifying was that he could clearly "see" everything that would unfold across this land within the next three hours—not vague fragments, but a complete picture rendered in perfect detail.

dialogue.content: "Excellent, truly worthy of the Chess Player I have waited countless ages for." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted out from the first page of the Tianji Record, a rare expression of relief appearing on his aged features, "From this day forth, you are the true Heavenly Secrets master—one who can glimpse Heavenly Secrets, reverse fate, and command causality. Three identities, three shackles, now all shattered."

text.content: However, before the words finished, Chen Ji felt a bone-piercing chill slicing through the void. It was the fluctuation of aura released the moment the Tianji Record became complete, piercing through thirty-six layers of prohibitions and surging straight into the nine heavens—as if announcing to the entire cultivation world that an existence capable of shaking the heavenly Chess Game had been born.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." A genderless voice echoed through the void—the Will Projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, "An ant dares to presume itself a Chess Player? Very well... This One shall see how many moves this newly ascended Heavenly Secrets master can make upon this board."

text.content: Meanwhile, above the clouds at the far northern reaches of the Heavenly Secrets continent. Within a white jade palace suspended beyond the nine heavens, a man seated before the Heavenly Dao Chessboard slowly opened his eyes. Cang Yutian—the Ultimate Chess Player, the supreme being who had held dominion over the three realms' Chess Game for countless ages—now had a flicker of... wariness in his gaze.

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record... is complete?" Cang Yutian's voice carried an air of disbelief, "That aura... it actually pierced through the thirty-three layers of Heavenly Secrets barriers I set!" He rose abruptly, the black and white pieces on the chessboard trembling, "This boy is a hundred times more troublesome than Chen Xuan of old!"

text.content: In the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The world in his gaze had completely changed—the originally blurry threads of fate were now clearly visible, each connecting different causalities. He saw Su Qingyao hurrying toward him, Lin Yuan stirring in the shadows, and Ye Qing in the distant Demonic Path raising her head to look in his direction.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao arrived through the air, and when she saw the galaxy runes swirling around Chen Ji, her footsteps halted abruptly, "You... you broke through? This aura... this is the true realm of Heavenly Secrets!" Her voice held shock, but even more disbelief, "Impossible, you're merely a Servant Disciple..."

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, facing this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow with a level gaze for the first time. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, that smile carrying an indefinable meaning: "Senior Sister Su, you're right—I am indeed merely a Servant Disciple." He paused, "But from today onward, this Tianqing Sect's Servant Disciple may force the entire cultivation world to reconsider."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply. She gazed at this man she had once despised, and a complex emotion surged in her heart—shock,不甘, but more of an inexplicable sense of... relief? "You've been hiding your true abilities all along?" Her voice was low, "From the very beginning?"

choice.prompt: How does Chen Ji respond to Su Qingyao's questioning?

choices.description: Since there's no more need for pretense, might as well lay everything bare and make Su Qingyao an informed party rather than an investigator.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the greatest advantage of playing the fool to devour the tiger
choices.visible_reward: Gaining a fully informed ally unlocks the prerequisite condition for 'Shared Destiny'
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may develop hostility due to years of deception

text.content: Chen Ji sighed lightly, those eyes that had always appeared timid now deep as an abyss: "Senior Sister Su, you've guessed correctly. From the very first day I found that fragment, I knew what kind of path I would have to walk." He raised his hand, and the galaxy runes flowed between his fingertips, "This path is too perilous—I had no choice but to hide."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao fell silent for a long while before finally nodding lightly: "No wonder... no wonder every time I approached the truth, I was interrupted by various accidents." She smiled bitterly, "Turns out from the very beginning, I was within your Chess Game."

choices.description: Exposing oneself at this moment is too dangerous—maintain the waste identity and make Su Qingyao part of the Chess Game.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to recruit Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage, the three major sects continue to underestimate you
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might continue investigating, bringing uncontrollable variables.

text.content: Chen Ji blinked, wearing an expression of bewildered helplessness: "What is Senior Sister Su talking about? I just... I just suddenly felt dizzy, and then I broke through this inexplicable realm." His voice carried just the right amount of confusion, "I really don't know anything about it."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao narrowed her eyes, her gaze like a blade: "Chen Ji, do you think I'm a three-year-old?" But she had no evidence after all, so she could only snort coldly and turn to leave, "This debt, I will eventually settle!"

choices.description: Admit to hiding one's true abilities, but attribute the reason to self-preservation, giving Su Qingyao a reason she can barely accept.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao might continue to suspect, but will not become an enemy.
choices.visible_reward: Establish initial trust, while keeping most of one's trump cards hidden.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's keen insight allows her to perceive more details.

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment before speaking slowly: "Senior Sister Su is right, I have indeed been hiding all along." His tone was calm, "But what if I told you it was the only choice I had? This Tianji Record... is a death sentence. No one who knows of its existence has ever escaped a grim fate."

dialogue.content: A hint of uncertainty flickered across Su Qingyao's features: "So you've been pretending to be worthless... for self-preservation?" Her voice carried a tone of disbelief, "Are you afraid of being silenced?"

text.content: The complete form of the Tianji Record unfurled slowly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The power that emerged from merging three fragments far exceeded his imagination—he could not only foresee three hours ahead, but also perform "Tianji Intervention" within those three hours: from changing a falling leaf's trajectory to warping the entire sect's destiny. The cost remained the Heavenly Fate Value, but now that he had become a Tianji person, his Heavenly Fate recovery rate was ten times faster than before.

Meanwhile, his Tianji Eye caught a crucial piece of information—Cang Yutian was mobilizing the power of the Heavenly Dao Chessboard, attempting to relocate his existence. More precisely, to reintegrate him into the chess game. "Want to make me a chess piece?" Chen Ji sneered, "But you'd better have the skill for that."

He saw three distinctly different paths into the future. First: pursue aggressively, use Tianji power to strike at the heart, eliminate Cang Yutian before he completes his setup. Second: proceed steadily, first consolidate cultivation in the Tianji realm, form a true alliance with Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and others. Third: continue strategizing, use the Tianji Eye as a chess piece, weave a massive net covering the Three Realms in the shadows.

choice.prompt: The Tianji realm has been achieved—how will Chen Ji choose his next step?

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot—Cang Yutian has just sensed his existence, his defenses are at their weakest, this is a rare battle opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may fall into the Heavenly Dao Chessboard's trap.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will directly end the threat of the ultimate chess player.
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian has operated this chess game for countless years, his foundation runs deep and unfathomable.

text.content: A sharp gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The Tianji realm granted him not only foresight ability but also an air of dominating the world—no longer a chess piece manipulated by heaven, but a true chess player. "Since you want to play chess with me," he murmured, "then let me show you what it means when heaven's secrets cannot be fathomed."

choices.description: Cang Yutian has operated for countless years, not something that can be shaken overnight. First stabilize cultivation, establish a true alliance.
choices.visible_cost: Give Cang Yutian breathing room, possibly allowing him to complete targeted strategies.
choices.visible_reward: The Tianji realm is completely stabilized, forming a community of destiny with Su Qingyao and others.
choices.risk_hint: The longer time passes, the stronger the gaze of the Heavenly Dao Eye becomes.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the battle intent in his heart. He was very clear—Cang Yutian was no simple-minded brute like Han Lie—that was a being who truly played against the Heavenly Dao. Acting rashly would only lead into a trap. "I need time," he murmured. "A true Heaven's Secrets person requires a body that can bear the Heavenly Secrets."

choices.text: A Secret Scheme in the Shadows
choices.description: Using the Tianji Eye as a tool, continue weaving that vast net that covers the Three Realms, making Cang Yutian a trapped beast within it.
choices.visible_cost: Requires continuous consumption of Heavenly Fate to maintain the operation of the Tianji Eye
choices.visible_reward: Bring all forces into the Chess Game, wait for the opportunity, and strike with certainty
choices.risk_hint: The scheme requires time, during which one must respond to the probing of various forces

text.content: A meaning-filled smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. The Tianji realm allowed him to see countless threads of cause and effect, and what he needed to do was place the key pieces at where these threads intertwined. "Cang Yutian, did you think I was here to play chess against you?" he said softly. "No—I will make the entire chessboard, my chessboard."

Just then, Chen Ji's brow furrowed. He sensed an extremely covert force probing the Tianqing Sect—that was Cang Yutian's Tianji Detection Art, attempting to lock onto his position. "Want to find me?" Chen Ji coldly snorted. In his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record violently trembled, and a profound power instantly and completely concealed his aura. "You're still too naive."

dialogue.content: In the Heavenly Dao White Jade Palace, Cang Yutian's eyes snapped open, his expression gloomy as water: "Impossible! How could his aura vanish into thin air? Even with the complete Tianji Record, it is impossible to completely shield this seat's detection!" His fingers struck several points on the chessboard, black and white pieces疯狂转动, yet they could never capture the trace of that aura.

text.content: "Interesting." Cang Yutian suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of madness. "It seems this game is far more exciting than this seat imagined. Chen Xuan's descendant... no, perhaps I should call you the new Chess Player." He sat back down, picking up a white piece. "Since you want to play, this seat will play along—just hope you can last a bit longer."

At the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds, Chen Ji withdrew his divine sense. A slight smile lifted at the corner of his mouth, his eyes blazing with dangerous light: "Cang Yutian, you thought I was a piece, but what you don't know is—from today onward, there will be no distinction between you and me on this chessboard." He slowly rose, the Stellar River Symbols around him slowly rotating. "We... are opponents."

The shackles of the three ending paths had been broken, but the direction was locked—whether pursuit, consolidation, or scheming, Chen Ji had already stepped onto the path of direct confrontation with the Ultimate Chess Player. And this was merely the prelude to a greater storm. When Chen Ji gazed down upon all living beings from the Tianji realm, Cang Yutian revealed a meaning-filled smile—the Chess Game had just begun.
